info.name: Tantra - Agriculture (Full Tree Seed)
info.description: Seeds the Agriculture tree: module -> 3 top-level categories -> subcategories -> all dropdowns -> all forms (Marketplace[Crop/Seed/Pesticide/Fertilizer/Equipment], Services, Repair). Animal/Poultry/Fishery/Veterinary moved to the Animal & Livestock module (see 12_AnimalLivestock_Seed). Run top-to-bottom on a clean DB.
